retained_support: A approved_layout, record samples[288,L-288), complete1024sample M2/M3 blocks
reference: A raw filtered ECG with A train-only median/IQR; no window cache ECG normalization
prediction_R_detector: A unified_metrics.waveform_events NeuroKit2 prominence, applied ONCE to cropped valid native waveform; same detected R for M1 and waveform R-F1

M1.name: R-aligned conditional beat morphology PCC
M1.reference_R: A audited raw-record reference R; all R in valid support form denominator
M1.reference_RR: following reference R-R interval; record's final R uses previous R-R only if no next R exists
M1.resampling: 200 endpoint-inclusive fractional positions using linear interpolation, NO extrapolation, shift fitting, amplitude fitting or polarity flips
M1.boundary: Match first; if either full morphology window exceeds retained support, flag boundary_excluded, preserve match in coverage, omit only from morphology PCC with scored_count and scored_coverage explicit
M1.aggregation: within-subject Fisher-z, then subject median/Q1/Q3 and arithmetic mean; no-scored subject explicitly unavailable, screening cannot pass missing M1
M1.coverage: matched GT R / ALL GT R within retained support; also report scored beats / ALL GT R
M1.status: REFERENCE-ASSISTED CONDITIONAL MORPHOLOGY, not native unaligned fidelity

M2.definition: unchanged A window_metrics, complete1024points, no lag/gain adjustment
M2.aggregation: subject Fisher-z then median[IQR] and mean

M3.definition: max PCC over integer lag -10..10, reference window[10:1014], prediction[10+lag:1014+lag], fixed1004sample comparison for ALL lags
M3.tie_break: largest PCC, then smallest absolute lag, then negative lag
M3.distribution: all21 lag-bin counts in ms and median/IQR/mean; positive/negative boundary counts visible
M3.aggregation: subject Fisher-z then median[IQR] and mean
M3.status: REFERENCE-SELECTED timing-tolerance diagnostic, never applied to M2 or deployable predictions

strict_beat: retain A all complete native GT R-R cycles, no alignment/resampling, flat prediction PCC0
event_head: unchanged frozen formal R-paired Q/R/S/T MAE (QST errors not truncated), head R-F1, coverage; predecode order separately
waveform_R_F1: same R used by M1; +/-150ms one-to-one; separate field from head R-F1
unit_tests: about10percent missing beats conditional M1 unchanged coverage approximately0.9
